verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a legal-document service covering notarization, apostilles, translations and company incorporation, so a repository for executed documents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows document upload and AI detection of signature and location/date fields for notarization, but nothing about a searchable repository of executed contracts or extraction of key terms and metadata. The field-detection feature is adjacent and earns no credit.
